description: This file defines the ProductOptionValue class, an entity representing values for product options in an e-commerce system. It includes properties such as id, sort order, image, code, descriptions, merchant store linkage, and display settings. The class uses JPA/Hibernate annotations for database mapping and validation annotations for input constraints.

classes.name: ProductOptionValue
classes.description: Entity class representing a product option value with associated properties, descriptions, images, and merchant store linkage, mapped to the PRODUCT_OPTION_VALUE database table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the product option value.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the product option value.

methods.name: getProductOptionValueSortOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the sort order of this product option value.

methods.name: setProductOptionValueSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order for this product option value.

methods.name: getProductOptionValueImage
methods.description: Gets the image associated with this value.

methods.name: setProductOptionValueImage
methods.description: Sets the image associated with this value.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of descriptions for this product option value.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the descriptions for this product option value.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Retrieves the merchant store linked to this product option value.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this product option value.

methods.name: setDescriptionsList
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions for this product option value.

methods.name: getDescriptionsList
methods.description: Gets the descriptions as a list.

methods.name: getDescriptionsSettoList
methods.description: Returns descriptions as a list, converting from set if necessary.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image file for this value.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Retrieves the image file for this value.

methods.name: isProductOptionDisplayOnly
methods.description: Checks if this option is display-only.

methods.name: setProductOptionDisplayOnly
methods.description: Sets whether this option is display-only.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifier for this value.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code identifier of this value.
